title: Guarded Thermal Bridge Interrogator
description: A sensor-module concept with independent cooling and guard excitation.
scope: Ten constructed lumped-model experiments. No physical motor, calibrated device, patentability finding, or controller safety bound.

cases.name: Above-range winding
cases.description: A 130 °C source saturates the resting pad readout at 95 °C. Controlled cooling returns the pad to range; independent guard excitation separates wire leakage and recovers the source temperature in this ideal model.

result.reason: Four thermal states are consistent with the assumed guarded model. This is not permission to energize a motor or proof that every heat path was modeled.

cases.name: Separate winding heat from wire loss
cases.description: With substantial heat escape through the wires, a simple cooled probe estimates 85 °C for a 130 °C source. The independent guard probe recovers 130 °C and distinguishes the two heat paths.

result.reason: Four thermal states are consistent with the assumed guarded model. This is not permission to energize a motor or proof that every heat path was modeled.

cases.name: Loose thermal attachment
cases.description: The pad cools readily, but the recovered attachment conductance is too small for the illustrative qualification threshold.

result.reason: The fitted thermal attachment is below the illustrative qualification threshold.

cases.name: Detached pad
cases.description: A pad disconnected from the hot source sits near the case temperature. The two readings cannot identify the hidden source.

result.reason: Insufficient temperature separation: attachment and source temperature are not identifiable.

cases.name: Cooling reference too hot
cases.description: A 100 °C case cannot passively pull the pad below a 95 °C readout limit. The result remains inconclusive.

result.reason: At least one measurement remains clipped or too close to the clip limit.

cases.name: Source changes after the fit
cases.description: The source increases by 10 °C before the fourth state. The independent challenge rejects the earlier estimate.

result.reason: The independent fourth state disagrees with the three-state fit.

cases.name: Challenge shunt miscalibrated
cases.description: The fourth cooling path provides only 70% of its calibrated conductance. Its temperature disagrees with the fitted model.

result.reason: The independent fourth state disagrees with the three-state fit.

cases.name: Failure the check cannot detect
cases.description: All shunts provide half their stated conductance. The check passes and overestimates attachment by 2×; a real weak bond looks qualified. Independent calibration is essential.

result.reason: Four thermal states are consistent with the assumed guarded model. This is not permission to energize a motor or proof that every heat path was modeled.

cases.name: Bypass the guard: false cool result
cases.description: An extra unmodeled path connects the pad directly to the case. Even the guard check passes while reporting 85 °C for a 130 °C source. Every significant parasitic path must be constrained.

result.reason: Four thermal states are consistent with the assumed guarded model. This is not permission to energize a motor or proof that every heat path was modeled.

cases.name: Readout stuck at 75 °C
cases.description: A plausible but unchanging readout supplies no separation across the cooling challenges, so the estimator withholds a result.

result.reason: Insufficient temperature separation: attachment and source temperature are not identifiable.
